absence_recalculation_requirement.manager_workflow: Manager removes the call-in employee or employees from that day's list. Recalculate all their assigned areas onto remaining staff in nearby general areas using the new 75% proximity / 25% load planning method.
recalculation_scope: Regenerate the affected employee plans, not base ownership alone.
Recalculate full-hour lunch relief using employees available for each entire window.
Recalculate inherited departure handoffs and ongoing current-area ownership as people leave.
absence_recalculation_requirement.resilience_target: Handle up to TWO absences as the normal target, most of the time. This is not a guarantee that all staffing, time and coverage constraints are always feasible.
absence_recalculation_requirement.third_absence: A THIRD absence normally means Eric would call CoverAll, then assign appropriate areas to available contractor coverage instead of manually reworking the weekly schedule.
absence_recalculation_requirement.failure_handling: If hours, staffing, full-hour relief or area coverage are infeasible, explicitly flag uncovered areas/windows and the constraint. Do not invent staff availability, silently relax constraints or claim guaranteed coverage.
absence_recalculation_requirement.contractor_authority: No automatic contractor booking, outreach or assumption that requested CoverAll staff are confirmed.
absence_recalculation_requirement.baseline_scope: Preserve accepted Monday–Thursday weekly baseline plans. No current assignments, shifts, reliefs or handoffs are changed by recording this requirement.
absence_recalculation_requirement.integration_gate: Integrate the completed planning system at the end. No build, audit, solver run, program/database change or implementation claim now.
absence_recalculation_requirement.formula_limit: 75/25 weighting intent is approved; exact normalization, distance metric and calculation remain to be finalized.
